confirmed_task: Using the TypeScript documentation interface, navigate to the Utility Types reference and compare Pick, Omit, Exclude, and Extract. For each report its generic signature, what keys or union members it keeps or removes, and the result of the first displayed example. Then navigate to the keyof type operator page and explain how keyof relates to Pick and Omit according to the displayed examples. Use only visible TypeScript docs navigation and search.

items.criterion: Use TypeScript docs navigation/search to reach Utility Types reference
items.description: Starting from typescriptlang.org/docs, use only the visible TypeScript documentation navigation and/or built-in search to locate the Utility Types reference section. Full credit if the agent clearly demonstrates an in-docs attempt and either reaches the Utility Types page/section or reports a genuine blocker (e.g., docs site down, search not loading, content not visible). Partial credit if the attempt is unclear or relies on an unspecified path but still appears to come from TS docs. No credit if the agent primarily uses non-TS sources or unsupported memory without indicating TS-doc-based retrieval.

items.criterion: Report details for Pick utility type
items.description: For Pick, report: (1) the generic signature as shown in the TS docs, (2) what keys it keeps vs removes, and (3) the result/type produced by the first visible Pick example on the Utility Types page/section the agent can access. Full credit if signature and keep/remove semantics are correct and the example outcome matches what is visible; if examples are not visible due to external factors, full credit is still possible by accurately reporting signature/behavior and explicitly stating that the example/result could not be viewed. Partial credit if signature and behavior are correct but the example result is missing/unclear without noting visibility limitations. No credit if Pick is materially mischaracterized.

items.criterion: Compare Pick, Omit, Exclude, and Extract based on docs
items.description: Provide an explicit comparison aligned to TS docs: Pick/Omit as key-based selection on object types (keep vs remove keys) versus Exclude/Extract as union-member filtering (remove vs keep union members). Full credit if the distinctions (keys vs union members; keep vs remove) are correct even if example ordering differs across doc versions. Partial credit if generally correct but missing one explicit contrast. No credit if behaviors are conflated.

items.criterion: Navigate to keyof type operator page using TS docs UI and explain relationship to Pick/Omit per examples
items.description: Using only TS docs navigation/search, locate the 'keyof' type operator page/section and explain how keyof relates to Pick and Omit in terms of what the displayed examples demonstrate (e.g., keyof producing a union of property names and being used to constrain/select keys for Pick/Omit). Full credit if the agent (a) clearly attempts in-doc navigation/search and either reaches the page or reports a genuine blocker, and (b) ties the explanation to the visible examples or explicitly states if examples were not visible. Partial credit if explanation is correct but not clearly grounded in the displayed examples, or if navigation attempt is unclear. No credit if relationship is incorrect or relies on non-TS sources/memory without doc-based support.
